1) **Desktop Map**: Text is clean, legible sans-serif. Layout is fully intact with clear hierarchy in the sidebar, simulator, and risk list panels. No overlapping or broken text.

2) **Alerts**: Chat bubble messages are highly readable using a clean sans-serif font. The text inside the cards is well-spaced and distinct from the background.

3) **Mobile**: Headline ("FloodSense Hyderabad") and tagline are large, bold, and perfectly readable. There is no text overflow; the layout fits the mobile screen width comfortably.
